name: io.github.lexmount/artifact-site
title: artifact-site
description: One place for every AI agent's pages and docs: versioned links to share, search and update.

environmentVariables.name: ARTIFACT_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your artifact-site deployment, e.g. https://artifact-site.app.lexmount.com. Optional after `artifact-site login`.

environmentVariables.name: ARTIFACT_SITE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal token from /for-agents#mcp on your deployment. Optional after `artifact-site login`; without it the server lists its tools and every call explains how to sign in.
